title: SCPN Fusion Core: Tokamak Plasma Physics Simulation and Neuro-Symbolic Control Suite
description: Tokamak plasma physics simulation and neuro-symbolic control suite in Python with a Rust acceleration workspace. It covers free-boundary and differentiable Grad-Shafranov equilibrium, MHD stability, integrated and coupled transport, heating, neutronics, runaway electrons, disruption prediction and control, and a Petri-net to stochastic-neuron compiler with optional SC-NeuroCore integration. Validation evidence is fail-closed: full-fidelity parity with external production codes is not claimed.
notes: Part of the SCPN (Self-Consistent Phenomenological Network) research framework by ANULUM. Published on Zenodo and Academia.edu.
